item.description:
The Rolling Stones - Massive Discography [MP3 320kbps]
Includes Hackney Diamonds (2023) + Qobuz Catalog + Extra Archives
By the time The Rolling Stones started calling themselves the greatest rock & roll band in the world in the sixties, they could actually claim this honorary title. As the rough alternative to the Beatles sound, the group brought energetic rock, often with a blues edge. Meanwhile, the British band belongs to the veterans of pop music and their iconic status is undisputed. Although the band members are quite old, the Stones still perform and release albums. In October 2023, their 24th studio album appeared under the title "Hackney Diamonds".
